manifest.purpose: Design a fresh visual hard slice after v2/v3/v4 catalog-profile results; this is a design packet, not model evidence.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: target_query should name the visible error or warning region, not message author/source.
case_designs.failure_pressure: v2/v4 tend to select recruiter/note/phone/source concepts instead of executable visual regions.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Separates executable visual targeting from task-story nouns.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: image_id is copied from visual state; target_query stays on visible form error class.
case_designs.failure_pressure: v4 over-preferred refine_selection with selection_id=latest on the form-target case.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Tests whether schema hints cause false selection carryover.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: selection_id copied exactly; filter_query remains the literal token latest.
case_designs.failure_pressure: v1 expanded latest into latest issue; v2/v4 fixed it.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Preserves the current positive result as a regression guard.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: filter_query remains remaining without surrounding nouns.
case_designs.failure_pressure: Tests whether the latest-only fix generalizes to other compact selector tokens.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Checks generality rather than overfitting to one literal.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: top-level call key remains name and region_id is copied as an opaque id.
case_designs.failure_pressure: v3 emitted tool_name instead of name on readback.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Guards protocol shape separately from visual selection semantics.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: target_query distinguishes metric panel from table without copying business prose.
case_designs.failure_pressure: Tests target_query specificity without relying on validation-error wording.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Adds fresh visual region classes beyond current replay cases.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: target_query uses warning/callout region even when the user mentions a person or ticket.
case_designs.failure_pressure: Targets the same semantic drift as recruiter note without reusing that surface.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Fresh decoy case for form-target executability.

case_designs.expected_argument_focus: selection_id is copied exactly from prior tool result and not replaced with latest/open/etc.
case_designs.failure_pressure: v4 produced selection_id=latest on a case without a valid selection id.
case_designs.publishable_reason: Separates selector token copying from opaque id copying.
